title: A test beyond the border: circuit boards etched by hand at The Crescent Moon (Mebsuta, lawless, 11 jumps) from the carbon and silicon ore the miners give the hauler receiver there, kept in its storage for the reserve
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-22 11:58 UTC (orders.log ENT-063, block APOLLO: the miners' gifts reach your receivers, craft the reserve's parts docked; requests.log ENT-350, Zero: a receiver at The Crescent Moon). The storage book of 11:53 UTC: the miners' stores at The Crescent Moon hold 4,384 carbon ore and 1,761 silicon ore (also 12,325 iron, 2,359 nickel); the Jishui carbon gather stores there with 10 ships. carbon_arc_circuit_etching makes 3 circuit boards from 2 silicon ore and 12 carbon ore by hand (catalog 0.732.0): about 1,095 boards from what lies there, against 24,360 boards net short (tool needs, action=items, 11:50 UTC). Boards carry 200 cr of base value a unit against about 2 for the ore, so a later haul home carries 1 unit for 4.7 of ore. Not known: whether this player station's workshop crafts for us; the first run says. Rule F3: one ship, empty hold, a test; F37: three results. The receiver: handover.py receivers (hauler at this base); the gifts begin once Zero gives his far gathers a gift.
